issues.message: Account public-access facts are missing; context was not scanned
AWSH-S3-004 requires logging; a related collection issue is recorded separately.

findings.title: S3 bucket public access safeguards are incomplete
findings.description: Bucket-level Block Public Access is missing or not fully enabled. This is potential exposure, not confirmation of public access.
findings.risk: Public policies or ACLs may expose data. Known account controls are shown in evidence and may still block access; effective anonymous access was not evaluated.
findings.remediation: Review intended access and enable all four bucket Block Public Access settings.

findings.title: S3 bucket versioning is not enabled
findings.risk: Overwrites and deletions may make data recovery harder.
findings.remediation: Enable bucket versioning and review lifecycle retention requirements.

findings.title: Instance permits IMDSv1
findings.description: Instance permits IMDSv1. This is configuration evidence; network routes, NACLs, and application controls are not evaluated.
findings.risk: The configuration may expose workloads or weaken protection of instance data.
findings.remediation: Restrict ingress and public addressing; require IMDSv2 and use encrypted EBS volumes as applicable.

findings.title: Instance has public IPv4 or IPv6 addressing
findings.description: Instance has public IPv4 or IPv6 addressing. This is configuration evidence; network routes, NACLs, and application controls are not evaluated.
findings.risk: The configuration may expose workloads or weaken protection of instance data.
findings.remediation: Restrict ingress and public addressing; require IMDSv2 and use encrypted EBS volumes as applicable.
